findings.observation: The free OpenRouter route has no independently verified processing-region, training, logging, retention, deletion, subprocessor, or incident evidence.
findings.evidence: docs/integrations.md denies private-evidence admission without those controls; the backend now requires source_locator synthetic: and parser_name synthetic* for every remote scope.
findings.user_impact: Real candidate conversations cannot silently cross the unadmitted provider boundary; attempts fail before the run journal or provider call.
findings.recommendation: Keep the synthetic-only gate until a provider-specific admission record and operational lifecycle audit exist.
findings.verification: Backend tests reject private/mixed evidence with AGENT_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SYNTHETIC_ONLY; a future admission test must cover retention, logging, deletion, training, subprocessors, and region.

findings.observation: The local journey was completed in the in-app browser because macOS Computer Use could not unlock the machine.
findings.evidence: Computer Use reported that the Mac is locked; desktop and 390-pixel browser checks completed with zero horizontal overflow.
findings.user_impact: The Web runtime is proven, but native pointer/keyboard replay remains unobserved in this evaluation.
findings.recommendation: Replay the same synthetic journey with native Computer Use after the Mac is unlocked.
findings.verification: Record login, Agent no_action, keep-unresolved review, visible receipt, and zero external effects from the native surface.

strengths: Exact reviewed evidence, confirmed attribution, source display name, parser version, Capture, Pursuit revision, and content fingerprints stay distinct and account-scoped.
The model has exactly four governed tools and cannot confirm state, bind identity, browse, use a shell, or create external effects.
no_action and keep_unresolved are first-class terminal states with durable receipts.
Proposal items require an explicit per-item decision and a written basis; no option is preselected.
A confirmed synthetic milestone refreshed from revision 1 to revision 2 while preserving the visible canonical receipt and recording zero external effects.
Credential sync copies only two allowlisted values, never prints them, and writes a 0600 ignored file.
missing_evidence: Independent provider lifecycle and commercial-use admission evidence.
Blinded human-gold evaluation and evaluator stability checks for proposal usefulness.
Native macOS Computer Use replay after unlock.
Production Web-to-backend identity exchange; the implemented Web adapter is intentionally localhost integration-only.
open_questions: Which provider, contract, region, and deletion-monitoring evidence would justify a future private-evidence admission?
Should the production UI expose a per-run remote-processing preview after a provider is admitted?
